canonical.title: A weekend at Ralf Berendsen: walk-home dinner, character lodging, day-trips and conferences within 30 km

sources.title: Ralf Berendsen — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: 2 Michelin stars at Paalsteenlaan 90, Neerharen; service Tue–Sat 18:30–21:00, Sun/Mon closed.

sources.title: Domaine La Butte aux Bois — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Relais & Châteaux address; restaurant on-site.

sources.title: Domaine La Butte aux Bois
sources.claim: Gastronomic-stay packages bundle the dinner with the room.

sources.title: La Butte aux Bois — Kayak
sources.claim: 62 rooms across Le Manoir / La Villa / La Forêt; Shiseido Spa Aquamarijn.

sources.title: Hotel Admiraal Lanaken — Kayak
sources.claim: Walking alternative ~€85, 1.1 km / 14-minute walk along N78.

sources.title: Kruisherenhotel Maastricht — Design Hotels
sources.claim: 15th-century Gothic monastery, design-hotel conversion.

sources.title: Worldtaximeter — Maastricht ↔ Lanaken
sources.claim: ~12-minute, ~€20 metered taxi between Maastricht and Lanaken.

sources.title: Château Neercanne — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Relais & Châteaux castle with its own Michelin star on-site — Friday-second-Michelin option.

sources.title: Kasteel Pietersheim — hotel
sources.claim: Moated kasteel 1.9 km from the restaurant; 5-minute taxi or walk through Domein Pietersheim.

sources.title: Hoge Kempen — Pietersheim gateway
sources.claim: Pietersheim doubles as a Hoge Kempen NP gateway with eight waymarked loops.

sources.title: Fort St Pieter + North Caves combo
sources.claim: Maastricht caves combo ticket via Fort St Pieter.

sources.title: Boekhandel Dominicanen — Visit Maastricht
sources.claim: Bookshop in a Gothic Dominican church — Maastricht highlight.

sources.title: Valkenburg Castle — Wikipedia
sources.claim: The only hill-top castle ruin in the Netherlands.

sources.title: Thermae 2000 Valkenburg
sources.claim: Thermal spa overlooking the Geul valley.

sources.title: Hoge Kempen — Terhills Trail
sources.claim: 14 km yellow loop with the iconic pontoon bridge.

sources.title: Tongeren antique market
sources.claim: Benelux's largest antique market, Sundays 07:00–13:00 (only day it runs).

sources.title: Jenevermuseum Hasselt
sources.claim: Working jenever distillery museum — tickets and hours.

sources.title: Lanaken → Drielandenpunt — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Drielandenpunt at ~36 km falls just outside the 30 km radius.

sources.claim: IEEE WCCI 21–26 Jun 2026 at MECC Maastricht (7 km).
